summary: Stock management ESM:  Unable to add user role scope on systems with many users
description:
In order to use the stock management functionality, users must be assigned to particular roles that have permission to do particular operations at particular locations.
The stock management ESM has a view for this, if you navigate to:
http://localhost:8080/openmrs/spa/stock-management/user-scopes
and click “Add New User Role Scope”
In our existing environment, if we have more users than the default maxResults configured in the REST module, then whatever users are not returned when the user endpoint is queried are unable to be found, and unable to have permissions granted.
To solve this, we need to either:
Do server-side searching / filtering of users, rather than client-side filtering

Implement server-side paging to ensure all results are fetched in batches so that client-side filtering has all possible values

 /  - maybe you could advise on the best practice here?
